column9: Secondary — the realistic route (comprehensive unless stated)
column10: Grammar / test route (bonus, not the plan)

column2: Kingston — North Kingston, Canbury / Park Rd (KT2 5/6)
column8: St Luke's CofE (no faith test; 0.30–0.61 km), Latchmere (1.0 km) and Fern Hill (Outstanding; 2.2 km); St Paul's, St Agatha's and St Joseph's offered every applicant. Alexandra only within ~250 m.
column9: The Kingston Academy — comprehensive, mixed; A8 64.6, P8 +1.16, Outstanding. Cut-off 1.20–1.30 km, so live within ~1 km of the Richmond Road entrance. Back-ups: Teddington School (comprehensive, mixed, A8 55.8; 5.1–5.8 km by road) and Coombe Girls' (comprehensive, girls, A8 57.2; Medium).
column10: Tiffin Girls' (grammar) is 1.1 km away and Canbury is in its Inner Area: up to 60 places for Inner Area girls ranked in the top 350.
column15: The Kingston Academy's margin is modest (0.9 vs 1.0 km comfort) and its measuring point moved in 2026. Kingston has no Tube; Waterloo trains take about 25–30 min.
column16: Best long-term: strongest primary + comprehensive pair, a grammar on the doorstep with local priority, and the cheapest, flattest rents.

column2: Richmond — St Margarets / East Twickenham, near Orleans Park (TW1)
column8: Orleans Primary (0.4 km; cut-offs 1.45–2.22 km in 2022–26) and St Stephen's CofE (spare places 2026); Deer Park (Outstanding, KS2 95%) only within ~400 m.
column9: Orleans Park — comprehensive, mixed; A8 66.4, P8 +0.88, Outstanding; 0.5 km against 1.11–1.24 km by walking route. Back-ups: Teddington School (comprehensive, mixed; 3.5 km vs 5.1 km), the Green School for Girls (CofE comprehensive, girls; community places to 10 km) and the Richmond upon Thames School (comprehensive, mixed, A8 52.9).
column10: Tiffin Girls' (grammar) 3.3 km; TW1 is in its Designated Area.
column15: Orleans Park's walking cut-off has tightened each year (1.24 → 1.19 → 1.11 km), so stay within ~0.8 km on foot. Richmond primary data for 2024–25 is missing (2022, 2023 and 2026 are in). Richmond rents rose 5.4%; listings median £2,450.
column16: Close second: an outstanding comprehensive in reach, several fall-backs, and within budget. New from the Richmond search.

column8: Dundonald (inside its priority area; 0.38–0.61 km) and Pelham (1.10–1.27 km); Merton Abbey offered every applicant.
column9: Harris Academy Wimbledon — comprehensive, mixed (10% music places); A8 55.8, P8 +0.62, Outstanding; 1.1 km against 1.61–1.92 km. Ricards Lodge — comprehensive, girls; A8 57.8, P8 +0.66, Outstanding; 1.2 km against 2.60–3.18 km. Both High.
column10: Tiffin Girls' (grammar) 6.8 km; SW19 is in its Designated Area. Nonsuch and Wallington: open places only.
column15: Merton rents rose 5.5% last year (about £2,630 by 2028). Dundonald's priority-area boundary matters: check the address.
column16: Safest London pair of comprehensives (two High), but the schools are a notch below Kingston Academy and Orleans Park.

column2: Epsom & Ewell — Epsom west, Stamford Green (KT18 7/KT19 8)
column8: Stamford Green (Outstanding; 1.10–1.49 km cut-off outside its catchment) and Southfield Park (spare places).
column9: Rosebery — comprehensive, girls; A8 61.6, P8 +0.79, Outstanding; 1.4 km against 2.68–3.29 km. Blenheim — comprehensive, mixed, A8 51.1; 1.1 km against 3.1–4.0 km. Both High, with big margins.
column10: Nonsuch (grammar) 4.3 km: inside its 5.25 km circle, which has up to 125 places for local girls. Tiffin Girls' Designated Area (KT18/19).
column15: Few 3-bed houses come up at once. The commute is longer (Epsom to Waterloo/Victoria about 35–40 min). There is no strong mixed comprehensive; the strong option is girls-only.
column16: Best outside London and the most certain on both phases. A house rather than a flat.

column8: Skyswood (Outstanding, KS2 88%; 0.49–0.80 km) and Wheatfields Infants (Outstanding; 1.40 km); St John Fisher (Catholic) had spare places.
column9: Sandringham — comprehensive, mixed; A8 65.7, P8 +1.06, Outstanding; 0.45 km, distance-only (Herts doesn't publish the last km). STAGS (comprehensive, girls) by lottery.
column10: Partially selective: Dame Alice Owen's (37.5% by test), Parmiter's and Watford Girls' (35%).
column15: Sandringham's last distance is unpublished. Little stock under £2,850 right now, and the highest commute cost.
column16: Strong on both phases, but the dearest commute. The best St Albans option for secondary.

column8: Thomson House (Outstanding), Sheen Mount, East Sheen (Outstanding) and St Mary Magdalen's all had places for everyone in 2026. Thomson House's 2023 cut-off was 0.49 km.
column9: Lift Richmond Park — comprehensive, mixed; A8 51.8 (just over the 'strong' bar), P8 +0.49; 0.7 km, High. Chiswick (comprehensive, A8 51.1) is borderline by walking route. No top-tier comprehensive (A8 60+) in reach.
column10: Tiffin Girls' (grammar) 5.0 km; SW14 is in its Designated Area.
column15: The secondary is solid rather than top-tier. Primary data is mostly 2023 and 2026.
column16: Excellent and cheap for primary; secondary is the weak link.

column2: Clapham — Between the Commons / Northcote Rd (SW11 1/6)
column8: Belleville (Outstanding; 0.89–1.21 km) and Honeywell Infant (KS2 84%; 0.78–1.41 km); several schools nearby had spare places.
column9: Ark Bolingbroke — comprehensive, mixed; A8 56.2, P8 +1.04. High via feeder places if Vera attends Belleville or Honeywell. Chestnut Grove (banded) Medium.
column10: Graveney and Burntwood: partially selective, 25% by the Wandsworth test. SW11 is outside Tiffin's Designated Area.
column15: Rent is over the £3,000 ceiling for typical stock (£2,775–3,045 now, rising about 4% a year).
column16: Best schools per square mile in London, but over budget.

column8: Fleetville Infant (Outstanding; 0.84–1.19 km) and Oakwood (1.05–2.95 km): both High.
column9: Beaumont — comprehensive, mixed; A8 63.0, P8 +0.89. Medium: it is your nearest school, but nearest-school applicants were offered only to 0.69 km in 2025 (1.36 km in 2026). STAGS by lottery; Sandringham unknown at 1.8 km.
column10: Partially selective: Dame Alice Owen's, Parmiter's, Watford Girls'.
column15: Secondary hinges on Beaumont's radius, which swung 0.69–1.36 km in two years.
column16: Top for primary, but secondary is a gamble; Marshalswick is the safer St Albans base.

column8: Bernards Heath Infant and Alban City offered every applicant; Maple and Garden Fields are tight.
column9: STAGS — comprehensive, girls; A8 60.7, P8 +0.55: High, as it is your nearest eligible school. Sandringham Medium (1.6 km, distance unpublished).
column10: Partially selective: Dame Alice Owen's, Parmiter's, Watford Girls'.
column15: A good fit for a girl (STAGS); weaker for a mixed school.
column16: Solid, but costlier commute than the London options.

column8: Barnes Primary (Outstanding) only within ~0.4 km (0.24–0.56 km). Lowther, East Sheen and St Mary Magdalen's had spare places.
column9: Lift Richmond Park (comprehensive, A8 51.8) High. Fulham Cross Girls' (comprehensive, girls, A8 58.1) offered everyone in 2025. West London Free School by ballot within 2 miles.
column10: Tiffin Girls' (grammar) 6.6 km; SW13 is in its Designated Area.
column15: Rent is at the ceiling now (£2,985 Hutch; £3,000 median) and rising. Hurlingham, Lady Margaret's open places and Christ's are out of reach.
column16: Lovely, but expensive for what the state schools offer.

column8: Meadow (cut-off 1.50 km; 0.8 km away) plus The Mead, Cuddington Community and West Ewell (spare places).
column9: Blenheim — comprehensive, mixed, A8 51.1: High. The strong comprehensives (Cheam, Rosebery, Harris Sutton) are out of reach.
column10: Nonsuch (grammar) 1.8 km, inside its 5.25 km circle: the strongest grammar position of any spot.
column15: Without Nonsuch, the comprehensive option is only above average.
column16: Good for primary and for an 11+ family. Otherwise weaker than Epsom west.
